markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
One-class conformal set, second model and 5/5 neighbors agree, despite blur. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 100%, InSitu <1% | Strongly benign |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 1.0 percentile | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Benign [F5] | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Scored below typical; no infiltration signal [F2] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Scored well below typical · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Scored high; fits benign pattern · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 5, 7) · ↓ invasive · Scored high; in situ is the alternative · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion CI excludes 0 (+0.54 logit drop, CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (+0.002, CI −0.005–0.007); not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules (0/20) is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Blur (severity 3) hides invasive detail; reliability score only modestly predicts errors (AUROC 0.69).
- Concept scores are unvalidated as drivers, so low scores cannot rule out invasion.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1** — older per-region probe gives 55% and 48% invasive; confirm benign morphology.
2. **Regions 6, 7, 9** — highest heatmap contribution; look for pleomorphism or necrosis.
3. **Regions 5, 7** — duct-confined atypia: benign versus in situ.
